ownerPasskeysExplanation: Register a login passkey, then allow it to open this Vault using your current and added passkeys. Changing access revokes existing shares and Agent permissions; approve them again afterward. The Vault locks after a change.
ownerPasskeysRecovery: If every usable Vault passkey is lost, this data cannot be recovered. Removing access cannot recall keys or plaintext already copied. Removing Vault access leaves login settings unchanged.
ownerPasskeysLoginOnly: Login only · Vault access not enabled
ownerPasskeysAuthorizeConfirm: Allow this passkey to open the same Vault? Confirm your current passkey, then the added passkey. Existing shares and Agent permissions will be revoked, and the Vault will lock.
ownerPasskeysRemoveConfirm: Remove this passkey's Vault access? Login settings remain unchanged. Existing shares and Agent permissions will be revoked, and the Vault will lock. Previously copied keys or plaintext cannot be recalled.
ownerPasskeysLoginAdded: Login passkey registered. Allow Vault access separately below.
ownerPasskeysFreshLogin: Sign in again before registering a passkey. This account may also have reached its passkey or pending-registration limit.
ownerPasskeysFailed: The operation could not be confirmed. If a retry button is shown, retry the same operation. Otherwise refresh the list or reopen the Vault before trying again.
ownerNameSharingIntro: Review the saved self-asserted display name before sharing. UserInfo service access and each app permission are separate choices.
ownerNameSharingCopyWarning: Revoking access cannot recall a name already read or copied by a service or app.
ownerNameSharingSourceChanged: The saved name changed. Refresh sharing status before reviewing access.
ownerNameSharingNoSavedName: Save a display name before managing name sharing.
ownerNameSharingRecipientUnavailable: The UserInfo recipient key could not be verified. New sharing grants are unavailable; existing access can still be withdrawn.
ownerNameSharingUserInfoPurpose: UserInfo service can decrypt this name to include it in identity information. This alone does not permit any app to receive it.
ownerNameSharingSystemTtl: The policy allows sharing for up to {seconds} seconds (approximately until {expires}).
ownerNameSharingPolicyDisabled: New sharing is disabled by policy. Existing access remains visible and can still be withdrawn.
ownerNameSharingStale: A previous share is no longer current for this saved record or recipient key.
ownerNameSharingExpired: The previous UserInfo share has expired.
ownerNameSharingRevoked: The previous UserInfo share was revoked.
ownerNameSharingNotActive: The saved name is not currently shared with UserInfo service.
ownerNameSharingShare: Share this saved name with UserInfo service
ownerNameSharingRpsCopy: Choose one registered app at a time. Signing in does not grant permission to receive your name.
ownerNameSharingRpTtl: The policy allows an app permission for up to {seconds} seconds (approximately until {expires}).
ownerNameSharingRpUnavailable: New app permissions are unavailable until the UserInfo share and policy are current. Existing permissions remain visible and can still be withdrawn.
ownerNameSharingNoRps: No eligible registered apps are available.
ownerNameSharingRpPurpose: Allowing {rp} lets this app receive the saved name in identity information.
ownerNameSharingRpActive: This app can receive the name until {expires}.
ownerNameSharingRpStale: A prior permission is no longer current for this app or saved record.
ownerNameSharingRpExpired: The prior app permission has expired.
ownerNameSharingRpRevoked: The prior app permission was withdrawn.
ownerNameSharingRpNotActive: This app does not currently have permission to receive the name.
ownerNameSharingAllow: Allow this app to receive my name
ownerNameSharingUpdated: Sharing status was refreshed from the service.
ownerNameSharingFailed: Sharing status could not be confirmed. Retry the same operation if offered, or refresh status.
ownerNameSharingRejected: The service rejected this change. Check the current status before approving again.
ownerWorkspaceLegacy: Open existing legacy names and notes
threadSearchFailed: Search is unavailable. Please try again.
threadSearchLimited: Showing the first 50 matches. Narrow your search.
ownerWorkspaceSharingPending: Manage connections here. Sharing this profile or these conversations is not supported yet.
title: Sign in to mikaki
intro: Use your passkey to sign in securely.
recovery: If you lose all passkeys, this account cannot be recovered.
error: Could not complete the operation. Please try again.
authHeroDescription: Sign in or create your account with a passkey.
homeBody: Start sign-in from the app you want to use. The login screen will show the app you are connecting to.
homeInvite: If you have an invitation code, you can create an account.
authOriginHint: Check it in your browser's address bar.
authCheckApp: Check the app below, then continue with your passkey.
authInviteHelp: If you received an invitation code, you can create an account here.
loginConsentDescription: Sign in and share your account identifier with this client.
parMissingBody: This link is missing a pushed authorization request. Return to the app and start again.
parInvalidBody: This authorization request link is invalid, expired, or already used. Return to the app and start again.
vaultIntro: Your display name is encrypted in this browser and unlocked with your passkey. If you lose the passkey, you cannot decrypt it.
vaultNotFound: No display name is saved. Unlock with your passkey to add one.
vaultLoaded: Unlock with your passkey to view your display name.
vaultReady: You can edit your display name. Saving will use your passkey again.
vaultSaved: Saved. Unlock with your passkey to verify it.
vaultUnsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
vaultPrfUnsupported: This passkey does not support PRF. Use a compatible passkey.
vaultCredentialMissing: Passkey information could not be loaded.
vaultRevisionInvalid: The stored revision could not be verified.
vaultRecordInvalid: The stored data format could not be verified.
vaultReadFailed: Your display name could not be loaded.
vaultNoteReadFailed: Your note could not be loaded.
vaultOpenFailed: The passkey could not unlock this value.
vaultInvalidName: Enter a display name of 1 to 256 characters.
vaultRetryChanged: The prior save result is unknown. Reload this page before changing it.
vaultPrepareFailed: The save operation could not be prepared.
vaultConflict: Another update conflicted. Reload this page to review it.
vaultWriteFailed: Save failed. You can retry with the same value.
vaultShareExplanation: Sharing lets the UserInfo service decrypt your saved display name until approximately {expiry}. It does not authorize release to any app.
vaultShare: Share saved name with UserInfo service
vaultShareActive: Your saved name is shared with the UserInfo service. Review app permissions separately below.
vaultShared: Sharing enabled. No app can receive the name without separate consent.
vaultShareFailed: Sharing could not be changed. You can retry.
vaultReleaseHeading: Apps allowed to receive your display name
vaultReleaseExplanation: Each app needs separate permission. Permission expires and can be withdrawn here. Sign-in alone does not share your name.
vaultReleaseGrant: Allow this app to receive my name
vaultReleaseGranted: Name permission granted to this app.
vaultReleaseFailed: Name permission could not be changed. You can retry.
invalidRedirectBody: This client's redirect URL is not registered.
adminIntro: Verify with your passkey to issue a single-use invitation for a new account.
adminError: The invitation could not be issued. Please try again.
adminReady: Share the invitation code through a secure channel.
enrollIntro: Enter your invitation code and register a passkey.
enrollCompleteBody: You can now sign in to your app with your passkey.
logoutBody: End this browser's sign-in and log out of connected apps.
logoutInvalidRequest: This logout request is invalid. Please start logout again.
helpHomeBody: Learn how to use passkeys and Mikaki. If you still need help, send a support ticket.
helpEmptyTickets: You have no support tickets yet.
helpNotFoundBody: The page or support ticket could not be found.
helpLoginRequired: Please log in to access support tickets.
helpSessionExpired: Your session has expired or you have been logged out. Please log in again.
helpInvalidTitle: Enter a subject of 1–120 characters without control characters.
helpInvalidMessage: Enter a message of 1–4,000 characters without null characters.
helpTicketChanged: The ticket has changed. Please reload the page.
helpInvalidRequest: The request could not be verified. Reload the page and try again.
helpRequestTooLarge: The request is too large. Shorten the content and try again.
helpLoginFailed: Login could not be verified. Please start login again from the home page.
helpServiceUnavailable: The service is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
helpPasskeysBody: Choose a passkey on the login screen and unlock your device. Your passkey is not sent to this service. Before changing devices, check that you have another way to log in.
helpVaultBody: Decrypting Vault requires a passkey that supports PRF. PRF is not needed for normal login. If you cannot decrypt your data, contact support before overwriting it.
helpSessionsBody: Each app has its own login session. Logging out of an app ends that app’s session. If you notice activity you do not recognize, contact an administrator.
agentExplanation: Choose the saved data, recipient, and expiry. A remote connection creates a separate copy that the Mikaki agent service can decrypt and disclose to the selected AI. Your original Vault keys are never shared. Revocation cannot recall content already delivered.
agentSelectLocalNote: Share my saved owner note through local MCP
agentLocalNoteScope: The note can be exported for local read access. Only saved content is included; unsaved edits are excluded. Selecting it disables remote access creation here.
agentLocalPreview: Review the saved content to export
agentLocalReady: Saved content prepared. Review it, then download both the data and grant for local read access.
agentReadScope: Allow listing, searching, and reading the selected copy
agentActionScope: Also allow proposing private drafts and executing drafts I approve. Drafts are stored as plaintext by the agent service and scheduled for deletion after 30 days.
agentConsent: I approve disclosure of the selected data to this recipient and provider
agentLocalDisclosure: The local export is plaintext. Keep it and its grant under your control; an agent with file access can bypass this adapter.
agentRemoteUnavailable: Remote agent access is not enabled in this deployment.
agentReady: Access prepared. Store the credential securely and configure only the intended client.
agentFailed: The agent operation could not be completed. Check the connection and retry.
vaultTransferHeading: Move my saved name to another Passkey
vaultTransferExplanation: Add a Passkey to this account, then move the saved name to it. Both Passkeys must be available on this device and support PRF. The new revision uses only the selected Passkey; existing attribute shares and agent snapshots will stop. Unsaved edits are excluded. Keep the original Passkey until you have reopened the saved name with the new one. This cannot recover data after every usable key is lost.
vaultTransferConsent: I approve adding a Passkey or moving my saved name to the selected Passkey.
vaultPasskeyAdd: Add a Passkey to this account
vaultPasskeyAdded: Passkey added. Select it to move a saved item; PRF support is checked during transfer. Registration alone does not recover existing Vault data.
vaultPasskeyFreshLogin: A login within the last five minutes is required. Sign in again and return here. Credential or pending-request capacity may also have been reached.
vaultPasskeyFailed: The operation could not be completed. The saved value has not been confirmed changed. Retry the same request or reload to check its recorded outcome.
vaultTransferTarget: Passkey to use for the saved name
vaultTransferAction: Move the saved name to this Passkey
vaultTransferSaved: Saved name moved. Unlock it with the selected Passkey to confirm. Previously shared copies need a new explicit share.
vaultTransferDiscarded: Pending request forgotten. Reload to check whether it was already committed; forgetting does not cancel a committed operation.
vaultNoteLoaded: Note loaded. Open it with your passkey.
vaultNoteReady: You can edit this note. Its provenance is self-asserted.
vaultNoteInvalid: Could not open this note. Unsupported formats or versions cannot be overwritten.
vaultNoteWriteFailed: Could not save. Check the input limits. If the response was lost, retry the same operation.
vaultNoteExported: Saved note exported as plaintext JSON.
vaultNoteImported: Note imported into the editor. The Vault changes only when you save.
vaultNoteInvalidImport: Unsupported note file. Your edits have not changed.
productNotePasskey: Move the note to another Passkey
vaultNoteTitleInvalid: Enter a title, or shorten it if it is too long.
vaultNoteTextInvalid: Enter note text, or shorten it if it is too long.
vaultNoteDisclosure: I consent to exporting the saved note as a plaintext file
vaultNoteReload: Discard edits and retry state, then reload note
agentNoteScope: Note proposals are a separate capability from name sharing and private drafts. The current note is not shared. Proposed values reach this service as plaintext for owner review.
agentNoteConsent: I consent to the selected connection proposing a note change at the displayed revision for up to one hour
agentNoteAllow: Allow note proposals for this connection
agentNoteDecided: Note decision recorded. The Vault has not changed.
agentNoteDecisionOnly: Proposals are untrusted AI output. Approval records your decision. Saving is a separate passkey operation: the proposal service receives the new revision’s one-time data key under encryption to check the exact value. Provenance is self-asserted, with no issuer assurance.
agentNoteApprove: Approve this note proposal (do not save yet)
agentNoteCommit: Encrypt and save the approved note
agentNoteCommitted: Approved note encrypted and saved to the Vault. Reload the owner note to open it.
agentNoteCommitFailed: Could not commit. Retry the same encrypted request. On conflict or expiry, reload and make a new proposal.
agentNoteCommitForget: Forget retry state and reload results (does not undo a commit)
agentOAuthAuthority: Access key generation {generation}, owner key revision {revision}
agentOAuthDisclosure: Authorize this registered public client to use one existing shared snapshot. Its client ID and label do not prove which person or bot is using it. No Vault owner key or additional attribute is shared.
agentOAuthNoGrant: Create a shared connection below with the requested operations, then refresh.
agentOAuthConsent: I approve this client, return address and these operations for the selected connection.
agentOAuthFailed: The authorization request is unavailable or its response was lost. Restart the connection from the client.
agentOwnerLoginLead: Sign in to return to your Vault.
agentOwnerLoginDescription: Signing in does not authorize the AI client. Review its connection and permissions in Vault after signing in.
vaultNoteTransferHeading: Move my saved note to another Passkey
vaultNoteTransferExplanation: Moves only this saved note, including its title and self-asserted provenance. Unsaved edits are excluded. Both Passkeys must return PRF output. Keep the original Passkey until you reopen the note with the selected Passkey. Your saved name and downloaded local AI copies are separate and remain unchanged.
vaultNoteTransferConsent: I approve adding a Passkey or moving my saved note to the selected Passkey.
vaultNoteTransferTarget: Passkey to use for the saved note
vaultNoteTransferAction: Move the saved note to this Passkey
vaultNoteTransferSaved: Saved note moved. Open it again with the selected Passkey to confirm. Prepare a new local AI export separately if needed.
agentSourcesExplanation: Checks the saved server record for each item without decrypting it. Times show when this browser confirmed a version, not when its content was updated. Each check is a separate observation; copies do not stay synchronized.
agentSourceSame: Same revision at the time of checking
agentSourceNewer: A newer saved revision was observed
agentSourceDifferent: Saved revision differs; reload to review
agentEditorRevision: Saved revision loaded in this page: {revision}
agentExportHistoryExplanation: Only plaintext downloads started in this page are recorded, up to 20. Downloaded files and grants remain independent copies. Updating or deleting Vault data does not recall them; reloading clears this page history.
productLogoutCompleteBody: Your session in this browser has ended. To use mikaki again, sign in from a connected app.
productVaultHint: Manage your encrypted profile and control its connections.
productProfileDiscard: Discard unsaved profile edits and pending retry information? The saved version will be loaded again.
productPasskeyCancelled: Passkey confirmation was cancelled or timed out. You can try again.
productProfileRefreshFailed: Your change was applied, but the updated profile could not be loaded. Reload to verify it.
vaultSessionLockedBody: This page locks after 15 minutes without interaction or one hour in total. Decrypted views and pending edits are cleared when it locks. Reopen and use your passkey to view saved data.
vaultSessionCheckingBody: Your Vault stays hidden until this browser’s sign-in session has been checked.
vaultSessionChanged: Your sign-in session ended or changed. Start from a connected app to sign in again, then reopen your saved data.
vaultSessionUnconfirmed: Your session could not be confirmed. The Vault has been locked. Check your connection and try again.
productVaultDiscard: Discard unsaved changes and unfinished operations, then lock Vault?
productNoteDiscard: Discard note edits and unfinished operations, then reload the saved note?
productProfileDeleteConfirm: Delete your saved name? This cannot be undone. Sharing of this saved name will stop.
productNoteDeleteConfirm: Delete your saved note? This cannot be undone. Unsaved note edits will also be discarded.
productUnsavedChanges: Unsaved changes. Save before leaving this page.
productTransferDiscard: Moving saved content will discard unsaved edits in this editor. Continue?
productDeleteFailed: Deletion could not be confirmed. Retry the same deletion, or reload to check saved content.
productUnfinishedOperation: An operation is unfinished. Retry it, or reload to check saved content.
productNoteRefreshFailed: Your change was applied, but the updated note could not be loaded. Reload to verify it.
authTiltUnavailable: Tilt is unavailable on this device.
ownerVaultPreview: Unified-unlock preview. Name and one saved note use separate new-format storage. The regular Vault is unchanged.
ownerVaultLockedBody: Open once with your passkey to read and edit your name and saved note for this bounded session.
ownerVaultOpenFailed: Vault could not be opened. Check your session and use the passkey that protects this Vault. No key was reset.
ownerVaultReady: Vault is open. Reading and ordinary saves use this session without another passkey prompt.
ownerVaultAdapterBoundary: Sharing, AI access, proposals and passkey transfer are not enabled for these new-format records yet. This preview never reads or shares the regular Vault’s older records.
ownerVaultDeletedHead: This item was deleted. Saving again explicitly creates a new revision after that deletion.
ownerVaultRecreateConfirm: This item was deleted. Save this content as a new revision after the deletion?
ownerVaultConflict: The saved revision changed or this operation conflicts. Reload to discard this attempt and check the current saved content.
ownerVaultRecordFailed: The operation could not be confirmed. A prepared write is kept unchanged for retry. Reload to check current data; unreadable records cannot be overwritten.
ownerVaultNewerHead: The operation was confirmed. A newer saved revision is now shown.
ownerVaultSaved: Saved and verified. Vault stays open.
ownerVaultRefreshFailed: The write was confirmed, but the saved content could not be rechecked. Reload before editing again.
threadSearchInvalidQuery: Use up to 8 space-separated search terms (256 characters maximum).
